spec.description:
Autex Solid Colour Cube is a lightweight, semi-rigid acoustic panel made
from 100% compressed polyester felt with solid colour throughout. Designed
without the need for edge banding or capping, Cube delivers exceptional design
flexibility and can be cut, bevelled, grooved, or pressed into high-performance
acoustic features. Available in 12mm and 24mm thicknesses, it achieves sound
absorption ratings from NRC 0.45 to 0.80 and complies with NCC Group 1 fire
regulations.

ceiling patterns

binders or formaldehyde

Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party
verified EPD
Extensive colour palette of 23+ contemporary solid colours

install: Ensure wall or ceiling substrate is flat, clean, dry, and dust-free

Acclimatise panels in the installation environment for at least 24 hours prior
to install

Inspect panels and ensure all sheets in a continuous area are from
the same batch

For adhesive direct-fixing, apply recommended high-grab MS
polymer or contact adhesive evenly across the panel back

Alternatively, use
Autex SpinFix mechanical fixings or Peel and Stick backing where specified

Position panel onto substrate, butt joins tightly together, and apply uniform
pressure across the surface with a roller

Trim edges neatly from the face
using a straight edge and sharp utility knife

to 3600mm)

Choose installation method (direct adhesive, SpinFix mechanical
clips, or Peel and Stick)

Verify substrate flatness and suitability for
adhesive or clip fixing
accessories: Autex Edging Solutions (Type B for 12mm, Type C for 24mm)

High-grab MS
polymer or contact adhesive
limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid direct exposure to water or high
humidity environments

Not recommended for areas subject to heavy mechanical
abrasion or impacts

Batch-to-batch colour variation may occur due to fibre
blending

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Solid Colour Cube is a lightweight, semi-rigid acoustic panel made
from 100% compressed polyester felt with solid color throughout its core.
Available in 12mm and 24mm thicknesses in 1220mm x 2440mm and 1220mm x 2740mm
sizes, it requires no edge capping and delivers sound absorption ratings from
NRC 0.45 to 0.80. Group 1 fire-rated under AS ISO 9705 and containing at
least 80% recycled PET, Cube offers endless design flexibility for walls,
ceilings, pinboards, and bespoke architectural features across commercial and
educational facilities.
